rule: disease in {malaria,TB} by title regex AND >=1 figscan forest figure AND T1 (methods text names RevMan) AND not already read in either ledger; ordered by sha256(pmcid); first 20 taken
why_t1: malaria/TB papers are 4.0%/7.7% productive (measured, paper level, 2026-07-16). A random sample would be ~19/20 single-arm prevalence plots and would test nothing. T1 selects on the FILTER (frozen, tuned on nothing), NOT on the outcome. This is a transfer test OF THE METHOD, not an estimate of malaria/TB yield.
contract: NEVER read for development. NEVER tuned on. Read ONCE, at the end, as the transfer test. Transfers => the claim is earned. Fails => we found the boundary, which is also a finding.

LIMITATION_TB_ONLY: FROZEN AS TB-ONLY, 13 papers, NOT the 20 requested and NOT malaria+TB. Stated rather than padded. Measured cause: malaria has only 2 T1 (RevMan) papers with forest figures in the ENTIRE corpus (2/28 = 7.1%, vs 34.3% corpus-wide), and both were already read for the yield analysis, so they are contaminated and cannot serve as a holdout. Malaria cannot supply a clean transfer test at any size. Padding this list with non-T1 malaria papers would have produced a test the method cannot pass or fail — single-arm prevalence plots contain no 2x2 to recover — i.e. verification theatre.
SECOND_FINDING_IN_THE_LIST_ITSELF: The TB holdout is dominated by Cochrane DIAGNOSTIC ACCURACY reviews (Xpert MTB/RIF, Truenat, FujiLAM). So TB's productive shape is DTA (TP/FP/FN/TN 2x2s), not comparative RCT synthesis. That refines the corollary: it is not that TB lacks poolable structure — it is that TB's poolable structure is DIAGNOSTIC, while the tournament's answer key is THERAPEUTIC. A method tuned on cardio RCT forests may fail here for a reason that has nothing to do with the disease.
transfer_test_scope: TB only. Malaria is untestable — see LIMITATION_TB_ONLY.
